<tr><th class="th"><div>Mar. 31, 2026</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsAbstract', window );"><strong>Organization, Consolidation and Presentation of Financial Statements [Abstract]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Organization</a></td>
<td class="text"><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-36pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">1.&#160;Organization</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Blackstone Multi-Strategy Hedge Fund L.P. (&#8220;BXHF&#8221;) is a Delaware limited partnership formed on October 28, 2025 and a private fund exempt from registration under Section 3(c)(7) of the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the &#8220;1940 Act&#8221;). BXHF is structured as a perpetual-life strategy, with monthly, fully funded subscriptions and periodic redemptions.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">BXHF expects to conduct a continuous private offering of its limited partnership units (&#8220;Units&#8221;) in reliance on exemptions from the registration requirements of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;1933 Act&#8221;), to investors that are both (a) accredited investors (as defined in Regulation D under the Securities Act) and (b) qualified purchasers (as defined in the 1940 Act and rules thereunder).</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">BXHF&#8217;s investment objective is to generate attractive long-term risk-adjusted returns across market cycles. BXHF will seek to meet its investment objective by investing dynamically in liquid and semi-liquid opportunities across four strategies: credit, equities, special situations and trading, each of which may have several underlying sub-strategies.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">As of March&#160;31, 2026, BXHF had not commenced investment operations. Certain subsidiaries were formed during the quarter for the purpose of supporting future investment activities. BXHF&#8217;s fiscal year ends on December 31 of each year.</span></div>Blackstone Alternative Asset Management Associates LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, is BXHF&#8217;s general partner (the &#8220;General Partner&#8221;). Overall responsibility for oversight of BXHF rests with the General Partner, subject to certain oversight rights held by BXHF&#8217;s board of directors (the &#8220;Board of Directors&#8221;). The General Partner will delegate BXHF&#8217;s portfolio management function to Blackstone Alternative Asset Management L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the &#8220;Investment Manager&#8221;). The Investment Manager will have discretion to make investments on behalf of BXHF. The Investment Manager expects to enter into a sub-investment management agreement (as may be amended, supplemented, restated or otherwise modified from time to time, the &#8220;Sub-Investment Management Agreement&#8221;) with Blackstone Alternative Solutions L.L.C. (the &#8220;Affiliated Sub-Investment Manager&#8221; and together with the Investment Manager, the &#8220;BXHF Managers&#8221;) pursuant to which the Investment Manager expects to delegate the portfolio management function for a portion of BXHF&#8217;s investments to the Affiliated Sub-Investment Manager. The BXHF Managers will be responsible for initiating, structuring, and negotiating BXHF&#8217;s investments. In addition, the BXHF Managers will actively manage and monitor each investment, as applicable, to seek to maximize value. Each of the BXHF Managers is registered with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (&#8220;SEC&#8221;) as an investment adviser under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, as amended (the &#8220;Advisers Act&#8221;). The General Partner, the Investment Manager or the Affiliated Sub-Investment Manager will provide administration services to BXHF and are individually and collectively referred to as the &#8220;Sponsor.&#8221; Each of the General Partner, Investment Manager and the Affiliated Sub-Investment Manager are affiliates of Blackstone Inc. (&#8220;Blackstone&#8221;).<span></span>
</td>
